rule.description: generate full name if not in ILM Vault
rule.comment: Full name policy: Generate a urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.formatted from urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.givenName + urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.familyName if one does not already exist. The value is set in the ILM Vault and in the current operation to Active Directory. This policy assumes that urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.formatted synchronization is enabled in the subscriber filter. If you disable urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.formatted in the subscriber filter you should not use urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User:name.formatted mapping.
